name: Technical Interview Prep
goal: Prepare for LeetCode-style coding interviews with algorithms, data structures, and clear solution reasoning
units: Unit 1: Interview Problem Solving - clarification, examples, constraints, and communication
Unit 2: Complexity and Tradeoffs - time, space, and choosing an approach
Unit 3: Arrays and Hashing - lookup, counting, and prefix patterns
Unit 5: Two Pointers - sorted inputs, partitioning, and in-place reasoning
Unit 6: Stacks and Queues - monotonic structures and traversal frontiers
Unit 7: Linked Lists - pointer manipulation, reversal, and cycle detection
Unit 8: Trees and Graphs - DFS, BFS, recursion, and iterative traversal
Unit 9: Backtracking and Dynamic Programming - state, choices, memoization, and pruning
Unit 10: Timed Interview Practice - communicate, implement, test, and improve
